# Satsplain

> Plain-English crypto guides for beginners. Every factual claim links to a regulator, an official document, or another primary source. This is education, not financial advice, and the site does not predict prices.

Satsplain is an independent research desk. Articles are researched and drafted with automated tools, fact-checked in a second pass against primary sources, and must pass an automated quality gate before publishing. Corrections are welcome at https://satsplain.com/contact/.

## Guides

- [What is a seed phrase? The words that control your crypto](https://satsplain.com/articles/what-is-a-seed-phrase/): A seed phrase is the list of words that can rebuild a crypto wallet. What it does, why losing it is permanent, and why nobody legitimate will ask for it.
- [Crypto scams to avoid (and how to spot them)](https://satsplain.com/articles/crypto-scams-to-avoid/): It starts as a friendly message. How crypto scams work, the flags in FBI and CFTC alerts, and where to report.
- [How to buy crypto safely for the first time](https://satsplain.com/articles/how-to-buy-crypto-safely/): The buy button is not the decision. Check the company, the fee, and who holds the keys before you pay.
- [What is Bitcoin? A plain‑English guide for beginners](https://satsplain.com/articles/what-is-bitcoin/): A friend says to just buy bitcoin. Here is what you hold, what a satoshi is, and the risks regulators name.

## Site

- [Start here](https://satsplain.com/start-here/): The beginner path, in order.
- [Glossary](https://satsplain.com/glossary/): Short definitions with the source for each word.
- [Editorial policy](https://satsplain.com/editorial-policy/): What a guide is allowed to say.
- [Sourcing](https://satsplain.com/sourcing/): Which documents we trust first.
- [Corrections](https://satsplain.com/corrections/): How to challenge a sentence, and the public log.
- [Disclaimer](https://satsplain.com/disclaimer/): Education, not financial advice.
- [Safety Kit](https://satsplain.com/safety-kit/): A blank steel seed-phrase plate, a punch, a pouch, and a setup card. Not for sale yet. Satsplain will sell it and says so on the page. A paper backup is enough.

## Optional

- [Full text summaries](https://satsplain.com/llms-full.txt): key takeaways and sources for each guide.
